headline: Pound most expensive in 21 months, dollar in 19 months. Zloty hit from all sides
summary: The zloty weakened clearly against major currencies as investors fled risky assets amid another bond-market sell-off. Oil prices rose again above USD 100 per barrel.
why: The zloty is Poland's currency, and it tends to weaken when global investors turn risk-averse or when oil import costs rise.
why_moved: Growing global risk aversion and another wave of bond-market selling pushed investors out of risky assets. A renewed oil price rise above USD 100 per barrel added pressure on regional currencies.
